name: Eternal Asia Supply Chain Management Ltd.
summary: Eternal Asia Supply Chain Management Ltd. provides supply chain management services in China. It engages in cross-border logistics, government and enterprise centralized procurement, and brand operation; and wholesale of alcoholic beverages, supply chain management, and import and export business. The company is also involved in house leasing business; business management and economic information consulting; and property management, machinery, and equipment maintenance and repair. Eternal Asia Supply Chain Management Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
